chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-ai-crea.description: Chanjing AI creation Open API client: submit image/video tasks, poll task status, list and get tasks, and optionally download outputs when the user runs download_result.py. Reads and writes local credentials.json; calls open-api.chanjing.cc.

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-avatar.description: Use Chanjing Avatar API for lip-syncing video generation (upload audio/video, create tasks, poll results).

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-credent.description: Guide users to configure local Chanjing credentials safely via local commands only, and validate local token status when needed.

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-customi.description: Use Chanjing customised person APIs to create, inspect, list, poll, and delete custom digital humans from uploaded source videos.

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-openapi.description: 查询蝉镜标签、消耗、价格，管理分片上传或生成创意 Briefing 时使用。需要已配置的蝉镜 OpenAPI AK/SK。

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-text-to.description: Use Chanjing text-to-digital-person APIs for AI portraits, talking videos, polling, and explicit downloads when requested.

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-tts.description: Use Chanjing TTS API to convert text to speech (list voices, create tasks, poll, download from returned URLs).

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-tts-voi.description: Use Chanjing TTS API to synthesize speech from text with a user-provided cloned voice (reference audio via public URL).

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-video-c.description: Use Chanjing video synthesis APIs to create digital human videos from text or audio, with optional background upload, polling, and explicit download.

chanjing-ai-chan-skills-chanjing-video-t.description: 创建蝉镜视频翻译任务或查询支持语言时使用。需要已配置的蝉镜 OpenAPI AK/SK。
